predecessors.name: Bahmani Sultanate
predecessors.text: the Bahmani province (taraf) of Berar, divided in 1478 or 1479 into the provinces of Gawil and Mahur, which Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk reunited under Ellichpur

successors.name: Ahmadnagar Sultanate
successors.text: Berar, annexed 'into his own dominions of the Ahmadnagar Sultanate in 1574' by Murtaza Nizam Shah I

ledger.x: 1490: Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk proclaims the independence of Berar from the Bahmani Sultanate at Ellichpur.
1574: the Imad Shahi sultanate ends; its land becomes part of the Ahmadnagar Sultanate.

wars.name: Ahmadnagar's annexation of Berar
wars.outcome: Ahmadnagar victory: the regent Tufail Khan and the deposed king Burhan Imad Shah are put to death and Berar is absorbed into the Ahmadnagar Sultanate.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary survey or treaty line for Berar; the frontiers with Khandesh, Ahmadnagar and Bidar are Cliopatria's approximations.
